newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: UBS group buys Dutch Tetra Laval unit.
newsitem.headline: UBS group buys Dutch Tetra Laval unit.

text.p: A group of investors led by UBS Capital BV, a wholly owned unit of Union Bank of Switzerland, has bought Tetra Laval Convenience Food from private Dutch group Tetra Laval Group.
Tetra Laval Convenience Food will be renamed Convenience Food Systems due to the change in ownership.

"Convenience Food Systems will operate on a stand-alone basis and UBS plans to introduce Convenience Food Systems to the stock market within the next five years," Tetra Laval Food said in a statement.
No financials details were disclosed on the deal.

Tetra Laval Convenience Food consists of 20 companies and five product centres, offering complete preparation, further processing and packaging solutions mainly for the meat, poultry, fish and seafood industries.
The head office is in Bakel, the Netherlands. Other units are based in the United States, Germany and Italy.
